'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Phil Johnson DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Phil Johnson]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Phil Johnson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif|label=Carbon Chamber Testing}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
